verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Obsidian stores notes as plain Markdown files locally on your device. You can use it offline with total control of your data, which delivers the local-only branch of the story. Community users confirm running it with notes stored only locally or synced through their own storage. missing for 10: no first-party self-hostable sync backend (cross-device sync without Obsidian's cloud relies on third-party services like Git or Dropbox)
